title: Passage 59
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Have you ever imagined the life in space?
sentences.cn: 你想象过太空中的生活吗？

sentences.en: The following will show you the astronauts' daily life.
sentences.cn: 下面将为你展示航天员们的日常生活。

sentences.en: Eating in space
sentences.cn: 太空饮食

sentences.en: Some foods can be eaten in their natural forms, such as chocolate cakes and bananas.
sentences.cn: 有些食物可以直接食用，比如巧克力蛋糕和香蕉。

sentences.en: Other foods require adding water, such as cheese.
sentences.cn: 而像奶酪等其他食物则需要加水。

sentences.en: Of course, an oven is provided at the space station to heat the food.
sentences.cn: 当然，空间站配备了烤箱来加热食物。

sentences.en: But there are no fridges, so space food must be kept properly.
sentences.cn: 但空间站没有冰箱，所以太空食物必须妥善保存。

sentences.en: Astronauts can never be careless with their food storage.
sentences.cn: 航天员在食物储存上绝不能大意。

sentences.en: Sleeping in space
sentences.cn: 太空睡眠

sentences.en: Astronauts go to bed at a certain time, then get up and prepare for work again.
sentences.cn: 航天员会在特定的时间睡觉，然后起床，再次准备工作。

sentences.en: They might set their alarm clocks to wake up at 6 a.m.
sentences.cn: 他们可能会定早上6点的闹钟起床。

sentences.en: When going to sleep, they have to attach themselves, so they don't float around or hit their bodies against something.
sentences.cn: 睡觉时，他们必须把自己固定住，以防四处飘浮或身体撞到东西。

sentences.en: They usually use sleeping bags located in small crew cabins.
sentences.cn: 他们通常使用位于小型乘员舱内的睡袋。

sentences.en: Each crew cabin is like a tiny apartment just big enough for one person.
sentences.cn: 每个乘员舱就像一个微型公寓，刚好够一个人住。

sentences.en: Exercise is an important part of every astronaut's daily life to prevent muscle loss.
sentences.cn: 运动是每位航天员日常生活的重要组成部分，以防止肌肉萎缩。

sentences.en: Usually, astronauts exercise two hours every day.
sentences.cn: 通常，航天员们每天锻炼两小时。

sentences.en: They might use a special gym with exercise machines.
sentences.cn: 他们可能会使用配有运动器械的特殊健身房。

sentences.en: Lifting 200 pounds on Earth may be a lot of work, but it would be much easier in space.
sentences.cn: 在地球上，举起200磅的重物可能很费劲。

sentences.en: That means the things for exercise need to be specially designed,
sentences.cn: 但是在太空中这会容易得多。这意味着用于锻炼的器材需要经过特殊设计，

sentences.en: so astronauts can receive the exercise needed to stay fit.
sentences.cn: 以便航天员能够获得维持健康所需的锻炼。

sentences.en: Living in space is not just all work and no play.
sentences.cn: 太空生活可不只是一味地工作而没有娱乐。

sentences.en: Astronauts have fun too.
sentences.cn: 航天员也会找乐子。

sentences.en: They might take photos of Earth or write in their diaries.
sentences.cn: 他们可能会拍摄地球的照片或写日记。

sentences.en: Fun plays an important role in the quality of their lives.
sentences.cn: 娱乐在他们的生活质量方面起着重要作用。
